newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP to look at all options for steel.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP to look at all options for steel.

text.p: The Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd said at its annual meeting on Tuesday that it continued to look at all options for its steel facilities and that it saw profitable opportunities in its copper business.
"We will continue to look at the options for all our facilities," chairman Brian Loton said.
BHP wrote off the value of the primary steel making facilities at its Newcastle works because of deteriorating cash flow projections from those assets.
On copper, Loton said opportunities were still present, with copper usage growing.

"Copper usage is growing not only in developing countries, but in developed ones as well and under these circumstances, BHP believes their are profitable opportunities in the copper business despite recent fluctuations in the price," he said.

Loton told the meeting the acquisition of Magma Copper Co for US$2.4 billion, completed earlier this year, had been strategically important to the company because it gave more options for marketing copper products.

"We have greatly increased our participation in the industry, with more customers and more products, and we now have access to the largest smelter in the important U.S. market for the output of Escondida and Tintaya," he said.
By 3.30 p.m. (0530 GMT), BHP shares were five cents higher at A$15.87 on turnover of 3.27 million shares.
